text:
```yaml
name: Danger Comment

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["Danger"]
    types:
      - completed

permissions:
  pull-requests: write
  checks: read

jobs:
  danger-pr-comment:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: 3.2
          bundler-cache: true
      - uses: danger/danger-pr-comment@v3
        with:
          danger-id: "danger"
          danger-cmd: "bundle exec danger"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
